title: SensitiveHUE: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection by Enhancing the Sensitivity to Normal Patterns
method_summary: 移除统计捷径增强正常依赖敏感性，利用异方差预测的不确定性与负对数似然评分。
reproduction_gap: 官方源码及CPU模型前后向已验证；Table4九行损失/结构变体已实现，论文公式与发布源码的均值缩放差异分开记录；完整训练及数值对齐待验收。

sources.archive: papers/flow matching/多变量时序异常检测文献.zip

anchors.review: curated synopsis; marker verified in extracted text; not a full-page manual review
